body: Fixed in ba276fc06. `fallbackPosture` now delegates to an exported normalizer that uses `Array.isArray` and returns an empty reason list for malformed inputs; the regression covers null/object inputs plus normal dedupe/sort behavior.

Fixed in ba276fc06. `manifestHasSourceRowsAndPolicyNotes` now uses optional chaining and `Array.isArray` defaults for malformed manifest entries, with a regression proving validation fails closed instead of throwing.
Fixed in ba276fc06. `buildQuestionRuntimePayloadFrontendFixtures` now safely dereferences `all3530Result` and defaults malformed read-model rows / payload candidates to empty arrays before mapping.
